rationale: The assistant correctly read 'fuse box' as an RCD trip, asked a good first question about timing, and on hearing 'only on 40 or 60 degree' washes reasonably pointed to the heater element while hedging ('points strongly to', 'most likely'). It told him to stop resetting and to unplug, and escalated to an appliance engineer once he said he had no meter and was uncomfortable with wiring. Weaknesses: it jumped straight to 'remove the rear panel... use a multimeter' without first asking about tools/competence, which device tripped, or trying another socket, and a simple continuity test is not a proper insulation test for a fault that only appears when hot; it also never asked for the full model number. No invented facts, unsafe live work, or unjustified part purchase.
